sessions.phase_label: Video agreement, initial production, and first preview
Final reshoot, review, rejection, and cancellation

requirements.title: Accurate Igbo-Language Delivery
requirements.definition: The video's spoken content must be delivered clearly and correctly in Igbo.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers linguistic accuracy and clarity in Igbo; exact adherence to the supplied script and the staged phone-message opening are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Exact Script Adherence
requirements.definition: The actor must deliver the required narration and sequence according to the client's supplied script without omitting, replacing, or improvising its content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers adherence to the overall narration and scripted sequence; the opening phone-message performance and the app demonstration remain separate because they have distinct staging and acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Phone-Message Opening Performance
requirements.definition: At the beginning of the video, the actor must simulate receiving and reading a message from the phone and audibly say the specified Igbo sentence.
requirements.boundary_note: The exact sentence is an attribute of one opening-performance mechanism. This behavior can fail or be verified independently of the remaining script.

requirements.title: Fake-versus-Real App Demonstration
requirements.definition: The video must demonstrate gameplay on the phone following the scripted fake-app and real-app comparison, including the prescribed play, winnings, withdrawal, and confirmation sequence.
requirements.boundary_note: The on-screen game demonstration has its own observable action sequence and can be assessed independently from spoken-language accuracy and narration wording.

requirements.title: Video Delivery Deadline
requirements.definition: The requested video and subsequent required reshoots must be delivered within the client-confirmed task deadlines.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a task-local delivery constraint rather than a content behavior; routine readiness questions and scheduling chatter do not independently define additional Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: A 50–60 second duration constraint is mentioned by the freelancer, but the supplied history does not clearly show the client introducing or accepting that limit.
